bibl.title: The Date of the Arrival of the Judeans at Elephantine and the Foundation of Their Colony.
bibl.seg: Dan'el Kahn, The Date of the Arrival of the Judeans at Elephantine and the Foundation of Their Colony.
bibl.note: The terminus ante quem for the Arrival of the Judean Colony to Elephantine. - The Possible Nature of the Judean Settlers at Elephantine. - Date of Arrival and Foundation of the Garrison. - Conclusion. [Most probably reign of Josiah, king of Judah (640-609 BC).] - Excursus.
